capabilities: Display notes created on this day in previous years
Read dates from metadata with ctime fallback
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and covers installation and settings but has no screenshots or examples.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resurface notes from this date in past years, so older journal or event notes stay buried.
summary: On-this-day viewer that lists your notes created on the same date in previous years in a sidebar panel.
